clause_a_text: Students must wear the prescribed institutional uniform on all working days and during all examinations conducted on campus.
clause_b_text: Students must wear the prescribed institutional uniform on all working days and during all examinations conducted on campus.

clause_a_text: All students must attend the mandatory orientation programme conducted at the beginning of each academic year.
clause_b_text: Attendance at the mandatory orientation programme held at the start of every academic year is compulsory for all students.
notes: Tuning: paraphrase — same obligation expressed differently.

clause_a_text: A student accumulating more than 3 disciplinary warnings in a semester will be placed on academic probation.
clause_b_text: A student accumulating more than 2 disciplinary warnings in a semester will be placed on academic probation.
notes: Tuning: warning threshold reduced from 3 to 2. Substantive.

clause_a_text: Students with active backlogs are permitted to participate in campus placement activities.
clause_b_text: Students with active backlogs are not permitted to participate in campus placement activities.
notes: Tuning: placement eligibility for backlog students reversed. Substantive.

clause_a_text: Faculty members should attend at least one national or international conference per academic year.
clause_b_text: Faculty members must attend at least one national or international conference per academic year.

clause_a_text: Students must clear all hostel dues by 31st March to be eligible for re-admission to the hostel in the following academic year.
clause_b_text: Students must clear all hostel dues by 28th February to be eligible for re-admission to the hostel in the following academic year.
notes: Tuning: hostel dues deadline moved one month earlier. Substantive.

clause_b_text: The institution shall maintain a Student Grievance Redressal Portal where students can submit complaints related to academic, administrative, or personal matters, and receive a response within 10 working days.
notes: Tuning: new student grievance portal clause added.

clause_a_text: Faculty members with more than 10 years of service are entitled to a sabbatical leave of one semester for research and academic development purposes.
notes: Tuning: sabbatical leave entitlement clause removed.

clause_a_text: 1.3 The librarian shall maintain a register of all books issued and returned, and submit a monthly report to the Principal.
clause_b_text: 2.3 The librarian shall maintain a register of all books issued and returned, and submit a monthly report to the Principal.
notes: Tuning: library clause renumbered, content unchanged.

clause_a_text: Fee concession requests will be evaluated by the Fee Concession Committee and decisions communicated to the student within 15 working days.
clause_b_text: The institution is committed to supporting deserving students through appropriate financial assistance as per available resources.
notes: Tuning: specific process and timeline replaced by vague commitment.

clause_a_text: The warden is responsible for maintaining discipline and order within the hostel and must submit a monthly discipline report to the administration.
clause_b_text: Hostel wardens are required to maintain discipline in the hostel premises and submit monthly discipline reports to the institutional administration.
notes: Tuning: same warden obligation, different phrasing.

clause_a_text: A late fee of Rs. 100 per day will be charged for examination fee payments made after the prescribed last date.
clause_b_text: A late fee of Rs. 200 per day will be charged for examination fee payments made after the prescribed last date.
notes: Tuning: late fee doubled from Rs. 100 to Rs. 200. Substantive.

clause_a_text: The institution shall ensure that the examination timetable is published at least 15 days before the commencement of end-semester examinations.
clause_b_text: The institution shall ensure that the examination timetable is published at least 15 days before the commencement of end-semester examinations.
notes: Tuning: identical examination timetable publication clause.

clause_a_text: The Head of Department must review the attendance register of all faculty members at the end of each month.
clause_b_text: The Head of Department may review the attendance register of faculty members periodically.
notes: Tuning: mandatory monthly review weakened to discretionary periodic review. Substantive.

clause_a_text: Students placed through campus recruitment are permitted to attend further placement drives conducted by the institution.
clause_b_text: Students who have already secured placement through campus recruitment are not permitted to attend further placement drives conducted by the institution.
notes: Tuning: placed students' access to further drives reversed. Substantive.
